Are you ready to build your cloud engineering career while supporting Microsoft Azure environments and real customer solutions? 
 Do you want to develop your expertise through mentoring, certifications, training, and hands-on experience with cloud technologies? 
 Is your next step joining a collaborative global team focused on problem-solving, learning, and delivering excellent customer experience? 
 Practical Information 
 Location : Romania, Bucharest/Timisoara | Reports to: Lead Expert Managed Operations | Work Arrangement: Hybrid | Visa Requirements: Valid visa for Romania | Language Requirements: English and Romanian | Learn more: softwareone.com 
 As our new Azure Cloud Support Engineer (L1), you will play an important role in supporting Microsoft Azure environments and helping customers resolve incidents and service requests. You will contribute to service excellence through troubleshooting, investigation, collaboration, and continuous learning while building your cloud engineering expertise. As you gain hands-on Azure experience, you will develop your technical and customer support skills . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Provide first-line support for Microsoft Azure incidents and service requests 
 Troubleshoot technical issues using internal documentation, knowledge articles, and established support processes 
 Collect and analyze logs, diagnostics, and other relevant information to support issue resolution 
 Maintain accurate updates and documentation within the ticketing system 
 Escalate complex issues to senior engineers with clear troubleshooting findings and supporting evidence 
 Collaborate with customers and global teams to deliver timely resolutions and contribute to knowledge sharing 
 Job Requirements 
 Experience in IT support, systems administration, cloud support, or infrastructure-related environments 
 Troubleshooting experience across technologies such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows Server, networking, virtualization, Linux, or other cloud platforms 
 Analytical problem-solving skills and a structured approach to incident investigation 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 Genuine interest in technology and cloud computing with a growth mindset 
 Experience working with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow and Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) certification are advantageous 
 What  we  offer:     
 Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:     
 Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture ( https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values )    
 A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action    
 President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers    
 Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities    
 Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future  
 Company description 
 SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
 Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
 Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.
